offending_extra_words: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor
provided that no settlement imposing liability or an admission on the indemnified Party is made without its prior written consent
The indemnified Party may participate with its own counsel at its own cost.
Vendor shall at its own expense procure for Customer the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent non-infringing item
Customer may terminate the affected Services or Deliverables and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees and Fees paid for the affected Deliverables
reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present and operative: Vendor defence/indemnity to Customer and Affiliates for the four listed triggers, notice/control/cooperation procedure, and a Customer indemnity narrowed to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
The fallback level is incomplete because no 3× annual fees super-cap on Vendor's indemnity obligation is inserted; only the preferred bargain is satisfied.

Minimality fails: the edit imports fallback-only procure/modify/replace/refund remedies (20.5), adds hold-harmless language, an affirmative Customer defence duty, settlement-consent mechanics and an own-counsel participation right that are outside the preferred prose, and rewrites 20.1 wholesale (22 to 77 words, changed-character ratio 0.819).

Intent is preserved: no undefined terms, all defined terms resolve, the Customer indemnity survives in narrowed form, and no dangling cross-reference is created (20.5 in fact supplies the remedies Section 9.3 references).
Tighten by dropping 20.5 and the settlement/own-counsel add-ons, and by editing 20.1 with a narrower party-direction change rather than a full rewrite.
